source: App design choice, not a rulebook citation: scenario selection weighting is a matter of how a group likes its games to feel, not a printed rule, so this file says so honestly rather than inventing a page reference. Wyrdstone Hunt is the game's default meeting engagement and is weighted heavily; the rest are even. `minCampaignBattles` gates a scenario until the campaign has that many battles logged — none of the nine core scenarios use it, but the field exists so a late-campaign finale can be added later without a code change.
